newsitem.title: USA: Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac adequately capitalized-HUD.
newsitem.headline: Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac adequately capitalized-HUD.

text.p: The Federal National Mortgage Association and the Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corp were adequately capitalized on June 30, 1996, an independent office of the Housing and Urban Development Department said Thursday.

HUD's Office of Federal Housing Enterprise Oversight said it determined that as of June 30 Fannie Mae's core capital of $11.751 billion exceeded its minimum capital requirement of $10.789 billion by $962 million.
The office said that as of June 30, Freddie Mac's core capital of $6.468 billion exceeded its minimum capital requirement of $6.213 billion by $255 million.
The HUD office, which reports to Congress, is required to determine at least quarterly the capital adequacy of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.
